glossary.definition: (C) "Shelter for victims of domestic violence" or "shelter" means a facility that provides temporary residential service or facilities to family or household members who are victims of domestic violence or to persons with whom the actor is or was in a dating relationship who are victims of domestic violence.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3113.33 to 3113.40 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3113.33 - Shelters for domestic violence victims definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Person living as a spouse" means a person who is living or has lived with the person committing the domestic violence in a common law marital relationship, who otherwise is cohabiting with the person committing the domestic violence, or who otherwise has cohabited with the person committing the domestic violence within five years prior to the date of the alleged occurrence of the act in question.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3113.33 to 3113.40 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3113.33 - Shelters for domestic violence victims definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Dating relationship" has the same meaning as in section 3113.31 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3113.33 to 3113.40 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3113.33 - Shelters for domestic violence victims definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Person with whom the actor is or was in a dating relationship" means an individual who, at the time of the conduct in question, is in a dating relationship with the actor who is an adult or who, within the twelve months preceding the conduct in question, has had a dating relationship with the actor who is an adult.
glossary.normalized: person with whom the actor is or was in a dating relationship
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3113.33 to 3113.40 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3113.33 - Shelters for domestic violence victims definitions.
glossary.term: Person with whom the actor is or was in a dating relationship

glossary.definition:
(G) "Actor" means a person who attempts to cause or causes bodily injury to another, or places another by threat of force in fear of imminent physical harm.
